---
title: Book a session
---

:::form {#booking next=/thanks/ button="Send request"}
- Your name * {autocomplete=name}
- Email * {type=email}
- Phone {type=tel}
- Preferred day {type=date}
- Session *
  - Morning
  - Afternoon
- Group size {type=select}
  - One
  - Two to four
  - Five or more
- What to bring {type=checkbox}
  - Notebook
  - Camera
- Anything else {type=textarea}

  We read every note before the session.
:::
